data: According to Tesla's Form 10-K for fiscal 2025, diluted earnings per share attributable to common stockholders were $1.08 in fiscal 2025, down from $2.04 in fiscal 2024. That is a decline of $0.96 per share, or about 47.1%. Net income for fiscal 2025 was $3,855 million, compared with $7,153 million in fiscal 2024. After subtracting $61 million attributable to noncontrolling and redeemable noncontrolling interests, net income attributable to common stockholders was $3,794 million in fiscal 2025, versus $7,091 million in fiscal 2024. The diluted EPS figure is calculated on that attributable amount, using 3,528 million weighted average diluted shares in fiscal 2025 and 3,498 million in fiscal 2024.
